firstPlayerRule: Choose one player to be dealer. The player to the left of the dealer goes first.
houseFallback: The rules do not say how to choose the dealer; use the picker.
clarifications: If the dealer starts the discard pile with a Skip card, the first player’s first turn is skipped.
